name: Winged Sentinel
description: Play the Winged Sentinel if you want to take flight and strike crushing blows from the sky.

foundation.name: Wings of Light
foundation.text:
You can fly. While flying, you can do the following:
• Mark a Stress to pick up and carry another willing creature approximately your size or smaller.
• Spend a Hope to deal an extra 1d8 damage on a successful attack.

specialization.name: Ethereal Visage
specialization.text: Your supernatural visage strikes awe and fear. While flying, you have advantage on Presence Rolls. When you succeed with Hope on a Presence Roll, you can remove a Fear from the GM’s Fear pool instead of gaining Hope.

mastery.name: Ascendant
mastery.text: Gain a permanent +4 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

mastery.name: Power of the Gods
mastery.text: While flying, you deal an extra 1d12 damage instead of 1d8 from your “Wings of Light” feature.
